name: Object outline fill
oneLiner: a clean pen drawing of a laptop, phone or camera draws itself on a drafting grid, then fills left to right in colour bands, one per cost part, each with a bracket and a label landing over it, and a dimension line runs out under it to stamp the real total
say: when the speaker breaks one price into its parts ('the laptop is $700 up front, then $1,000 in subscriptions, then fees'): cut in on the object, each band fills as its part is named, the total stamps on 'so it really costs...'
